conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I tried checking my loan balance online, but it says ‘account not found.’ Help!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the trouble, ma’am. Can you confirm your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s two three nine, eight seven four, one one five eight. I don’t know why it’s not showing up.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It seems your account isn’t linked to the portal. I’ll link it now and send you login instructions.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Okay, but I’m not good with these online things. Will it be easy?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s very simple, ma’am. I’ll also send a guide, and you can call me if you need help.
